_comment: The AI model registry: what we may call, how to address it, and what it costs. AI_AND_COMMERCE_ARCHITECTURE.md §A.2/§A.7. Ships WITH the code on purpose -- the fee table went stale for three weeks because the deployed S3 config silently outranked the code default (plans/TODO.md, 'the DEPLOYED fee table was three weeks stale'), so this has exactly one source and travels with the deploy that uses it.
_rates_comment: USD per 1,000,000 tokens. AWS publishes NONE of these machine-readably: all 1052 us-west-2 Bedrock price records carry zero current-generation models (Anthropic stops at Claude 3; the only OpenAI rows are gpt-oss), and the pricing page lists the models without per-token rates. So these are hand-maintained and each carries its confidence. Reconcile against Cost Explorer, which bills third-party models under the PROVIDER, not under Bedrock.
_id_comment: `profile` is an inference-profile id, never a bare model id: us-west-2 offers no In-Region inference for this generation, so `anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6` fails where `us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6` works.

sonnet-4.6.label: Claude Sonnet 4.6
sonnet-4.6.notes: Best measured result for page composition: richest output and the most careful hedging on facts it was not given. EOL no sooner than 2027-02-17.

sonnet-4.5.label: Claude Sonnet 4.5
sonnet-4.5.notes: Fewer sections than 4.6 and volunteered an invented cancellation term. Kept as a fallback, not a default.

opus-4.6.label: Claude Opus 4.6
opus-4.6.notes: 1.6x Sonnet 4.6 for no measured gain on this task, and it invented a cancellation term too. Not for page-gen.

haiku-4.5.label: Claude Haiku 4.5
haiku-4.5.notes: BARRED from page generation (§A.7): cheapest and the only model that drifted on facts -- turned a given '5g per serving' into '5g per gummy', added a taste claim and an efficacy claim. Fine for classification or extraction where nothing is asserted to a buyer.
